Settings

Every setting on the box.

Tap the sliders icon to open settings. It's six tiles on one page.

Light
Brightness, 10 steps.
Theme
9 color themes. Mono (black on white) is easiest to read in bright sun.
Battery
Shows the charge. Says Charging while plugged in. Tap it for Power saver.
Power saver
On the battery screen. Dims after 30 seconds and turns the screen off after 5 minutes, instead of 1 minute and 10.
Tips
Shows "Locked. Tap the padlock." when someone taps a locked screen.
Lock
Off, Manual or Auto. About the lock →
Screen
Normal or Flipped. Flip it to read it from the other side, like when a charger cable is in the way.

Set when you start a game

Players
3 to 15.
Imposters
Up to half the players.
Hint
Word mode. On or off for the imposter.
Meetings
Tag mode. 0 to 9 emergency meetings, shared by everyone.

Around the box

Info
Top left of the menu. The rules, your code for playing on a phone, the version number, and a QR code to this site.
Off
Top right of the menu. Turns the screen off. Tap to wake it.
Sleep
Dims after 1 minute and turns off after 10. Tap to wake it right where you were. It never sleeps during a tag cooldown.
Low battery
A red badge on the menu at 20%.
